body:
The human can't see the planning agent's last message: it gets hidden.

Likely causes, from `plan.run_view`:
- All notes are drawn first and all questions (proposals) after, so a note the agent writes after a proposal lands **above** it, out of sight and out of order.
- The conversation doesn't follow new messages: nothing scrolls the panel to the newest one, and the transcript and message box below it push it further down.

Fix:
- Draw notes and proposals as one conversation in the order they happened. If a question has no time today, give it one when it is asked (server side, in the strategy run's record), and order one without a time after the notes that came before it.
- When a new message or proposal arrives and the human was at (or near) the bottom, scroll to it; if they had scrolled up to read, don't jump, show a "New message ↓" button instead. Opening a run starts at its newest message.
- The agent transcript moves out of the conversation's flow (e.g. a collapsed section at the top of the run, or a toggle in the run header) so it never sits between the newest message and the message box.

First reproduce with the human's case to confirm the cause before fixing; if it is something else (e.g. the note isn't streamed until the agent's call returns), fix that and say so in the task notes.

**Tests:** Gleam tests that notes and proposals interleave by time, and that a note after a proposal is drawn after it.
title: plan: agent's latest message stays visible
